Definition: an Arbathite or inhabitant of (Beth-) Arabah
BiblicalUsage: The word means an Arbathite, a man of Beth-arabah, and it appears twice, naming Abi-albon the Arbathite among David's mighty men and Abiel the Arbathite in the chronicler's list of the same men.
TheologicalSignificance: A man from a little town in the Arabah can stand among David's mighty men, and the lists keep his name.
